substantialPassDefinition: A pass that changes public positioning, adds or activates consequential claims, or ingests ten or more sources.
polishingCap: After a substantial pass, complete one outward field action before another discretionary archive pass unless new evidence would correct a consequential public claim or safety risk.

controls.signalSource: A versioned aggregate reader-study receipt; none exists yet.
controls.trigger: Before another discretionary archive pass after this substantial portfolio pass.
controls.nextTest: Run the bounded reader study against the frozen surfaces and retain only aggregate findings.
controls.decisionRule: Treat the first study as a baseline. Revise only repeated comprehension or trust failures; do not infer hiring effectiveness from the sample.
controls.evidenceReturn: A public-safe aggregate receipt with sample size, task conditions, dimension counts, decisions, and limitations.

controls.currentState: 25 of 31 inquiries are partially recovered; one is recovered.
controls.trigger: When a priority inquiry is selected for another research pass.
controls.nextTest: Pursue only the named evidence target, then close, bound, or explicitly reschedule the inquiry.
controls.decisionRule: Continue research only when the named evidence could change a consequential public claim or active hiring decision.
controls.evidenceReturn: Updated inquiry state and a dated public-safe finding or bounded disposition.

controls.signalSource: Claim evidence relationships, confidence, projection state, and roleEvidencePolicy.
controls.currentState: Role-specific public evidence is strong for some actions and incomplete for several broad authorship or founding memories.
controls.trigger: Before activating or strengthening first-person authorship, founding, ownership, or causal wording.
controls.nextTest: Review active role wording against the evidence-class threshold and demote or explicitly attribute first-person-only claims.
controls.decisionRule: Project importance never substitutes for role evidence; collective and individual propositions remain separate.
controls.evidenceReturn: Claim relationship update, projection decision, guardrail, and reviewed date.

controls.signalSource: Live source-kind distribution plus per-project invisible-work review.
controls.currentState: The bank spans 12 source kinds, but recent full-population work favors enumerable platform traces.
controls.trigger: After a full-population platform pass or before choosing research only by source volume.
controls.nextTest: Review the same project for maintenance, facilitation, coordination, repair, documentation, follow-through, and handoff evidence.
controls.decisionRule: Trace count, post count, and engagement count cannot rank professional importance or select public claims.
controls.evidenceReturn: A project-level lead, bounded non-recovery, or explicit no-change decision.

controls.signalSource: composition-manifest.json and the live public routes.
controls.currentState: Mature claims are selected separately from public composition; the technical-operations page was reduced during this pass.
controls.trigger: Before adding a public claim or when a page exceeds its claim budget.
controls.nextTest: Run a short subtraction review and the external reader protocol on the named primary surfaces.
controls.decisionRule: A claim enters a page only when it supports that page's audience decision and governing argument within budget.
controls.evidenceReturn: Manifest update with selected claims, omission rationale, and any subtraction decision.

controls.currentState: A dated combination-level review exists; it does not eliminate future aggregation risk.
controls.trigger: After a substantial ingestion, before activating a relationship-rich claim set, and before production release.
controls.nextTest: Repeat the review against the rendered public surface after the next substantial ingestion.
controls.decisionRule: Remove or generalize detail when professional value is weaker than the relationship, movement, affiliation, or inference risk it creates.
controls.evidenceReturn: A dated public-safe receipt recording scope, risks, minimizations, and limitations without the underlying relationship graph.

controls.signalSource: Separate judge artifacts bound to the same bundle digest.
controls.currentState: The initial independent LLM round failed and supplied revisions; qualifying rounds must use separate immutable artifacts.
controls.trigger: After material changes to this control bundle.
controls.nextTest: Run both read-only judge roles twice against one unchanged bundle and retain their separate outputs and limitations.
controls.decisionRule: The generator cannot decide the result; deterministic checks recompute scores but cannot certify truth or external usefulness.
controls.evidenceReturn: Distinct judge artifacts, session provenance, bundle digest, score recomputation, and disclosed limitations.

controls.signalSource: fieldActionProtocol and a privacy-safe external action receipt; no completion receipt exists yet.
controls.currentState: One hiring-reader solicitation is planned for July 18, 2026; it is not completed.
controls.trigger: This pass qualifies as substantial; the action is due before another discretionary archive pass.
controls.nextTest: Send a bounded hiring-reader solicitation, then complete one outward application, referral request, or comparable job-search action after reviewing aggregate findings.
controls.decisionRule: Repository work alone cannot satisfy this control. Completion requires a dated external attempt; outcome success remains unmeasured.
controls.evidenceReturn: Outside the repo, retain private details; in the repo retain only coarse status, date, action class, aggregate learning, and copy decision.

readerStudyProtocol.sample: Five consented readers: at least two hiring-adjacent readers and one implementation, civic-tech, or product-operations peer. Assign two readers to the home page, two to technical operations, and one to Fair Rent NYC; all five must attempt the resume and contact destinations.
readerStudyProtocol.exposure: Five minutes without coaching, followed by a structured recall task.
taskOrder: Open the assigned entry page without coaching.
Browse for no more than five minutes.
State Jamie's role in the reader's own words.
Name one remembered proof and likely team fit.
Name one trust or confusion concern and one concrete reason to contact Jamie.
Locate the resume and contact path while time is recorded.
readerStudyProtocol.baseline: No prior comparable study; this run establishes the baseline.
readerStudyProtocol.clarityThreshold: At least four of five identify the target role accurately, at least three recall one concrete proof, and all five locate both the resume and contact paths within 90 seconds.
readerStudyProtocol.entrySurfaceDecisionRule: Use global thresholds for the baseline. Make a page-specific change only after the same failure appears for at least two assigned readers; the single Fair Rent observation is a directional lead that requires another reader or independent evidence before page-specific revision.
readerStudyProtocol.fairRentFollowUpTrigger: If the assigned Fair Rent reader misses role, proof, or role fit, or records a trust or confusion concern, recruit one additional consented reader for that same entry page before making a page-specific revision.
readerStudyProtocol.decisionLink: Repeated failures trigger subtraction or clarification on the affected page; passing the threshold does not establish interview or hiring impact.
readerStudyProtocol.privacyBoundary: Keep names, employers, applications, verbatim private feedback, and individual response records outside the repository. Separate hiring-reader and collaborator aggregates.

receiptTransition.plannedToAttempted: Requires a dated external solicitation recorded outside the repository.
receiptTransition.attemptedToReviewed: Requires a public-safe aggregate receipt with sample size, conditions, dimension counts, decisions, and limitations.
receiptTransition.forbiddenShortcut: A repository edit, LLM judgment, or deterministic check cannot advance this state.

priorityInquiryControls.evidenceTarget: A contemporaneous founding or early operating artifact plus collaborator confirmation of Jamie's specific actions.
priorityInquiryControls.closureCondition: Action-level founding, convening, web, or operations propositions have direct role evidence and explicit collective-work boundaries.
priorityInquiryControls.boundedDisposition: Keep the broad instrumental-role projection on hold and publish only separately sourced actions.

priorityInquiryControls.evidenceTarget: Event production records or collaborator confirmation assigning concrete planning, logistics, facilitation, or follow-through actions.
priorityInquiryControls.closureCondition: At least one production action is directly corroborated and distinguished from collective advocacy.
priorityInquiryControls.boundedDisposition: Retain documented invitation and speaking participation; state that the complete production role remains under research.

priorityInquiryControls.evidenceTarget: Campaign revision history, publishing records, testimony, or collaborator confirmation tied to Jamie's specific work.
priorityInquiryControls.closureCondition: Individual actions and the policy chronology have separate support and no sole-causality implication.
priorityInquiryControls.boundedDisposition: Keep the campaign chronology collective and Jamie's individual role under research.

priorityInquiryControls.evidenceTarget: Public-safe contractor, grant, inspection, or collaborator records assigning Phase One coordination and completion facts.
priorityInquiryControls.closureCondition: General-contractor and trade-coordination claims have direct role evidence and completion scope is bounded to Phase One.
priorityInquiryControls.boundedDisposition: Retain the grant-supported work scope and Jamie's first-person role account without asserting complete independent corroboration.

priorityInquiryControls.evidenceTarget: Archived exhibition materials or collaborator records naming NTER CHNG and production roles.
priorityInquiryControls.closureCondition: Exhibition inclusion and Jamie's production role are independently and separately supported.
priorityInquiryControls.boundedDisposition: Describe the recovered project and institutional exhibition context without inferring the missing show's full record.

priorityInquiryControls.evidenceTarget: Canonical source relationships for consequential active portfolio claims that still rely on descriptive proof notes.
priorityInquiryControls.closureCondition: Every consequential active claim is cited, explicitly bounded, or intentionally removed.
priorityInquiryControls.boundedDisposition: Keep uncited consequential wording conservative and log the missing relationship.

roleEvidencePolicy.strongIndividualWording: Requires one high-confidence direct contemporaneous role source, or two independent corroborating sources including a collaborator or official attribution.
roleEvidencePolicy.firstPersonOnlyWording: May remain active only when explicitly attributed as Jamie's account, paired with independent project-context evidence, and bounded against sole authorship; otherwise hold.
roleEvidencePolicy.collectiveOutcomeWording: Requires separate evidence for Jamie's action and for the collective or institutional outcome; chronology alone is not causality.
roleEvidencePolicy.structuredDerivation: The exact-set role-evidence-classifications.json ledger must equal every active or held Knowledge Bank claim whose projection names Jamie. Each record cites only evidence already attached to that claim and classifies it as source-corroborated, first-person, mixed, or open.

sourceBalanceReview.stopRule: Do not open a broad archive pass solely because a platform population is countable. Open a targeted lead only when it could change a consequential role claim or active hiring decision.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: Large social and press populations can eclipse convening, meeting production, policy translation, maintenance, and handoff.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: Protected revision records and public event records support targeted operating claims; broader founding responsibility remains an open inquiry.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Pursue only role-specific founding or production evidence that could change active wording.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: Public votes and posts can eclipse daily construction coordination, field listening, maintenance, and stewardship transition.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: Phase One role remains a priority inquiry; the stewardship transition stays bounded without a private reason.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Seek a role-specific public-safe construction record before strengthening the general-contractor claim.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: Event and post counts can eclipse moderation, taxonomy work, partner support, maintenance, and community facilitation.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: Platform populations remain scale context, not a ranking of effort or impact; social-management attribution remains inconclusive.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Prefer product records or collaborator confirmation over another broad platform count.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: Council-member account engagement can overshadow product translation, data work, interface design, and archival maintenance.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: The public project, repository, reporting, and bounded engagement review support separate product and traction claims.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Do not expand engagement research unless it changes a consequential stakeholder-use claim.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: Event and participant counts can obscure hosting, space preparation, onboarding, continuity, care, and self-service access.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: A protected workflow supports one concrete operating sequence; aggregate scale remains separately bounded.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Seek participant-safe operating evidence only when it improves the active case-study argument.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: Revenue and analytics traces can crowd out legacy-system maintenance, operational translation, staff support, and durable handoff.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: Keep private operational detail protected and use approved aggregate claims; primary source wiring remains a priority.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Pursue a canonical role-and-outcome source relationship rather than additional surface metrics.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: A complete personal social timeline can overrepresent public posting while underrepresenting private coordination, maintenance, repair, and long-term handoff work across projects.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: The personal-account population is a bounded lead index, not a professional activity ledger; role claims still require project-level evidence.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Use personal posts only to route targeted source recovery that could alter a consequential claim.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: Hosted-event associations can make visible event titles and dates while hiding facilitation, preparation, access work, care, follow-through, and collective authorship.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: Facebook association is treated as a historical locator, not proof of attendance, production responsibility, or impact.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Pursue event-specific production evidence only when it can resolve an active role question.

projectReviews.platformTraceRisk: A collaborator-led post population can eclipse the behind-the-scenes web, naming, deployment, maintenance, and handoff work that made the campaign usable.
projectReviews.evidenceDisposition: The public Page supports campaign chronology and shared identity; Jamie's bounded technical role is separately attributed and code-corroborated.
projectReviews.nextDecision: Seek collaborator confirmation only if it would materially refine the naming or responsibility boundary.

fieldActionProtocol.timeBox: 30 minutes to recruit and send; five minutes of review time requested per reader.
fieldActionProtocol.completionEvidence: A dated external attempt recorded outside the repository and a coarse public-safe receipt with no recipient identity.
fieldActionProtocol.requiredFollowThrough: After reviewing aggregate findings, complete one dated application, referral request, or comparable outward job-search action before another discretionary archive pass.
fieldActionProtocol.safeStorage: Private outreach and feedback remain outside the repository; only aggregate learning and resulting content decisions may be committed.

receiptTransition.plannedToAttempted: Requires a dated external action outside the repository.
receiptTransition.attemptedToLearned: Requires a coarse public-safe receipt naming only action class, date, aggregate learning, and any content decision.
receiptTransition.forbiddenShortcut: Archive work, site edits, LLM scores, and internal checks do not count as an external attempt.

followThrough.trigger: After aggregate hiring-reader findings are reviewed and before another discretionary archive pass.
followThrough.privacyBoundary: Keep recipient, employer, role, application, referral, and message details outside the public repository.
